{{Vanilla|End City}}
An '''end city''' generates in [[The End]] as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes only its chest loot.

Compared to vanilla, the treasure chest:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/end_city_treasure.json}}</ref>
* rolls 5–8 times instead of 2–6;
* replaces the individual diamond and iron tools and armor with the pack's shared diamond equipment table (weight 20), enchanted randomly;
* adds blocks of iron (5–12), and gives more diamonds (5–9 instead of 2–7) and iron ingots (12–16 instead of 4–8);
* gives 1–3 {{ItemLink|Obol|obols}} instead of 2–6 emeralds;
* drops beetroot seeds, saddles and copper and iron horse armor. Golden and diamond horse armor remain.
